name: pleasure
description: A tangibly positive experience to the body or social self.

variations.name: social pleasure
variations.description: A positive experience with people who you respect in some way and perceive they return the respect in some measure.

variations.name: physical pleasure
variations.description: Reward signals in the brain coming from the body.

variations.name: existential pleasure
variations.description: A sense that something's happened that brings you existential merit. This can range from a sense of meaning to religious ecstasy.

commentaries.quote: Hedonism is the outlook that seeking pleasure is the way to organize your life. Though the body clearly rewards certain behaviors, it's not clear we were meant to chase them to the extent we often do.

conditions: Self perceives that a social interaction of at least moderate importance went well.
The brain is releasing reward chemicals like dopamine.
